items.problem: Bootstrap omitted csproj-linked source files outside the project directory.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 119-143 copied only seven files; lines 639-685 and 2208-2765 show manual recovery from obj and SharedContent.
items.skill_search: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copy loop and searches for Link/SharedContent
items.root_cause: The script recursively copied only physical descendants of -Source and ignored evaluated Include/Link project items.
items.proposed_fix: Parse legacy csproj Link metadata, resolve shared path properties, and copy linked files to their logical paths before namespace rewrite and mapping.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP projects and SDK samples frequently share App/MainPage, resource dictionaries, code, and assets through linked project items.

items.problem: GetForCurrentView guidance omitted InputPane/CoreInputView and validation allowed the forbidden calls to remain.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3324-3700 shows fabricated replacements and reversion; build-output.txt lines 8-12 shows five WUI0004 warnings after validator PASS.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Replace GetForCurrentView() with a window-scoped factory; the table had no InputPane/CoreInputView exception, and the validator scanned unsupported/residueOnly but not this adaptable pattern.
items.root_cause: These input APIs have no Microsoft.UI.Input projection/GetForWindowId factory, while the validator assumed analyzer availability would catch unresolved adaptable calls.
items.proposed_fix: Document HWND COM interop for InputPane/CoreInputView, mark GetForCurrentView mustResolve, and re-scan mustResolve patterns during validation.
items.generalizes: Any UWP app using view-scoped APIs can compile with invalid legacy calls when analyzer packages are absent.

items.problem: The skill instructed agents to use a nonexistent winapp build command.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3107-3168: winapp rejected build and the agent had to switch commands.
items.root_cause: winapp handles package identity/launch but does not expose a build subcommand in this environment.
items.proposed_fix: Use native dotnet build throughout and reserve Test-AppLaunch/winapp for registration and launch.
items.generalizes: Every migration must compile, and stale command guidance wastes a turn in every environment with the current CLI.
